title: Postern version check response
description: The answer a distributor gives when asked which version of an agent it currently offers, and the source of status.update.latest (SPEC.md section 4.4). Postern defines no path for it: section 5 fixes the two distributor paths a runner must call to serve its agent at all, and a version answer is neither, so a distributor offering one publishes how in its own profile. Section 8 records Sigrix's. Unauthenticated, because the answer names no buyer and carries nothing beyond an identifier and a version string.

postern.description: The specification version this payload conforms to, carried like every other success payload in the protocol. A client MUST NOT infer it from the /postern/v0/ path prefix, which VERSIONING.md keeps deliberately coarser.

agent_id.description: The identifier the request addressed (SPEC.md section 1.5), echoed octet-for-octet. A mismatch is a failed check rather than something for a runner to reconcile, the same rule the entitlement answer follows.

version.description: The version the distributor currently offers. Compared against the runner's own describe.agent.version for equality only: equal means current, unequal means an update is available. No ordering is implied, so a client MUST NOT read one version as newer than another, and a distributor is free to change its versioning scheme without breaking that comparison.
